Format all code using the linter formatter:
make build_staging
make test_staging
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsTests/YourTestClass/testMethodName
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsDataModelTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsServerTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsUtilsTests
Use `DataManager.sharedManager` for data operations. Strings: `podcasts/en.lproj/Localizable.strings`, generated `L10n`; snake_case keys, context/placeholders comments, positional specifiers, manual `_singular`/`_plural`. Use `naturalContentHorizontalAlignment` instead of `.left`/`.right`; `.natural` instead of `.left`. Never use `LocalizedStringKey` in SwiftUI - use `NSLocalizedString` with L10n. For themed Views use `<REDACTED_USER> private var theme: Theme`, inject `.environmentObject(Theme.sharedTheme)`, and access colors with `AppTheme.color(for: .primaryText01, theme: theme)`.
brew install protobuf swift-protobuf  # One-time setup
make update_proto API_PATH=/path/to/pocketcasts-api/api/modules/protobuf/src/main/proto
